{{Quote|"You are bound to enjoy today's special, Baked dru'un slices in fish sauce. Wait here, and I will bring you some."|A [[Unidentified rectory droid|rectory droid]] offers baked dru'un slices in fish sauce to Jedi Master Yoda|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
'''Baked dru'un slices in fish sauce''' was a meal consisting of slices of baked [[dru'un]] served in a [[Fish/Legends|fish]] [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]]. The meal was served in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] as one of the specials in the [[Jedi Temple refectory/Legends|Jedi Temple Refectory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] attempted to eat a bowl of [[Gender/Legends|his]] own specially prepared [[Yoda's stew|stew]] in the refectory, which wasn't served there normally, a [[Unidentified rectory droid|rectory droid]] attempted to take the stew as it couldn't identify it as [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. The [[Cooking droid/Legends|droid]] offered to replace Yoda's meal with the day's special, which was baked dru'un slices in fish sauce and after breaking the bowl of Yoda's stew, it successfully served him a plate of the special. During a free-for-all battle between a number of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] that took place later that day in the refectory, a number of plates of baked dru'un slices in fish sauce were knocked to the floor.<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous" />

==Behind the scenes==
Baked dru'un slices in fish sauce was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' written by [[Sean Stewart]] and published in [[2004]].
